high_level_description: The image depicts a pavilion located in Denantou Park in Lausanne. The pavilion is ornate and features traditional Thai architectural elements, including a pointed, multi-tiered roof with intricate gold detailing. The structure has a red and gold color scheme, with the roof adorned with golden spires and decorative elements that resemble Thai temple architecture. In the foreground, there is a grassy area where two adults and a child are standing, seemingly observing the pavilion.
